title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 51
description: Ten questions on Psalms 51: a prayer for mercy and cleansing: wash me, purify me with hyssop, create in me a clean heart.

questions.text: According to verse 1, the psalmist asks for mercy according to God's what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 51:1 says, "Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness."

questions.text: In what does the psalmist say he was born?
questions.explanation: Psalms 51:5 says, "Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin."

questions.text: With what does the psalmist ask to be purified?
questions.explanation: Psalms 51:7 says, "Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean."

questions.text: If God washes him, he will be whiter than what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 51:7 says, "Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow."

questions.text: In verse 8, what does the psalmist hope may rejoice?
questions.explanation: Psalms 51:8 says, "Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice."

answers.text: The bones which God has broken

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask God to create in him?
questions.explanation: Psalms 51:10 says, "Create in me a clean heart, O God."

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask God not to take from him?
questions.explanation: Psalms 51:11 says, "Don't throw me from your presence, and don't take your Holy Spirit from me."

questions.text: In verse 15, what does the psalmist ask the Lord to open?
questions.explanation: Psalms 51:15 says, "Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise."

questions.text: According to verse 17, what are the sacrifices of God?
questions.explanation: Psalms 51:17 says, "The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit."

questions.text: In verse 18, what is God asked to build?
questions.explanation: Psalms 51:18 says, "Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem."
